user.title: Connect to a KDE Connect device
user.description: Enter the device's IP address or hostname. Home Assistant probes the device over UDP 1716 to discover its device id and TCP port.

pair.title: Pairing
pair.description: Open KDE Connect on the device and accept the pairing request for "Home Assistant". Then press Continue.

abort.already_configured: This KDE Connect device is already configured.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the device over UDP 1716 or complete the TLS handshake. Check that KDE Connect is running and discoverable on the network.
abort.pairing_timeout: The device did not confirm pairing within the timeout.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the device.
error.invalid_port: Invalid TCP port: must be between 1716 and 1764.
error.pairing_timeout: Pairing was not confirmed by the device yet. Approve it in KDE Connect and try again.

init.title: KDE Connect options
init.description: Default SMS recipients (one per line, phone numbers).

pairing_pending.title: KDE Connect pairing is pending
pairing_pending.description: Open KDE Connect on {device_name} and accept the pairing request with Home Assistant.

send_notification.name: Send notification
send_notification.description: Displays a notification on the paired KDE Connect device.

send_sms.name: Send SMS
send_sms.description: Sends an SMS through the paired KDE Connect device.

phone_number.name: Phone number
phone_number.description: Recipient number. Uses configured default recipients when omitted.

find_my_phone.name: Find my phone
find_my_phone.description: Triggers the device's find-my-phone plugin (ring and vibrate).

ring.name: Ring
ring.description: Play the configured ringtone on the device.

request_notifications.name: Request notifications
request_notifications.description: Asks the device to push its current notifications to Home Assistant.

cancel_notification.name: Cancel notification
cancel_notification.description: Removes an active notification on the device.

notification_id.name: Notification id
notification_id.description: Id of the notification to cancel.

notification_reply.name: Reply to notification
notification_reply.description: Replies to a notification on the device that supports replies.

reply_id.name: Reply id
reply_id.description: replyId of the notification being replied to.

run_command.name: Run command
run_command.description: Runs a command registered by the device's run-command plugin.

command.name: Command
command.description: Command key from the device command list.
